test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The length and breadth of a hall are 16 m and 13 m, respectively. A dog runs along all four walls once to catch the bone. How much total distance does the dog cover?
solution:
Given: The length and breadth of a hall are 16 m and 13 m, respectively.

 

A dog runs along all four walls once to catch the bone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3ab062ecff38308918fed3b8b5a07e8316e2a192c82f67a862713d3c332a89f.png] 

So, the total distance covered by dog = 16 + 13 + 16 + 13 = 58m.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
